descFull: CanvasAnvil is an open source AI diagram maker and flowchart generator - an infinite-canvas diagram editor and self-hosted drawio alternative that writes editable .drawio files. Text to diagram, then fix nodes, layout and labels in place. Also AI presentations, interior design CAD/BOM, posters and infographics.
